column1: # Known plugin library — read by the audio plugin manager.
# This file is the single place where per-plugin knowledge lives.  It used to be
# a heredoc inside lib-audio-plugin-manager-core.sh, which meant the table could
# not be reviewed, extended or referenced on its own — the thing you asked for.
# Format: pipe-separated, `#` starts a comment, blank lines ignored.
# (Pipe rather than tab, to match fixes_catalog and the other tables here; a `|`
# must not appear inside a note.)
#   token      lowercase substring matched against the INSTALLER path.  Matching
#              is first-hit-wins in file order, so put specific tokens first
#              ("install xfer" before "xfer") and the vendor-wide catch-alls
#   prefix     wine prefix, relative to $HOME.  ".wine-vst" is the default for
#              plugins, ".wine-ableton" is reserved for Ableton and its own
#   runtime    wine runtime the plugin's EDITOR needs:
#                         here with the DirectComposition + NSPA patches
#              "ableton" is set where a stock staging build is known to crash the
#              editor.  This is a *recommendation surfaced in the wizard*, not a
#              silent change: the active runtime stays whatever is configured in
#   needs32    yes when the plugin ships a 32-bit VST that must be bridged, no
#              when the plugin is 64-bit only, unknown when not established.
#   note       shown in the wizard next to the recommendation.
# The runtime column only records what has actually been observed on this
# machine.  "unknown" is a deliberate value, not a placeholder: it means nobody
# has established the answer yet, and the wizard says so rather than implying a
serum|.wine-vst|ableton|no|Serum 2's editor is a DirectComposition surface; it crashes under stock wine-staging, and the d2d1-nspa runtime is the only local build with DComp + NSPA
crispytuner|.wine-vst|ableton|unknown|Editor needs XWayland input; see the wine_gui_input fix
ableton|.wine-ableton|ableton|no|Kept out of the shared VST folders deliberately; its own prefix
